title: WaveTrend behaviour atlas (9 frozen cells)

what.name: Idea
what.value_plain: WaveTrend (LazyBear) oscillator events on BTCUSDT: touches of the +/-53 band, crosses and pivots, each in a context of trend, higher-timeframe zone, volatility or time of day.
what.label: OURS

what.name: Oscillator settings
what.value_plain: hlc3, EMA 10, EMA 21, SMA 4, 0.015, bands +/-53 and +/-60
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Outcome
what.value_plain: Signed return from the open after the event to the close 12 bars later, in the direction the event implies, before fees and funding.
what.label: OURS

what.name: Cells and tests
what.value_plain: 9 cells frozen before the run, Holm correction over 9 (no tuning after the result).
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: None: this is a gross behaviour table, not a strategy test.
what.label: OURS

how: Count events, then measure the gross 12-bar outcome for each frozen cell and compare with the same events without the context, the indicator alone and a random clock. Nothing is adopted from it.
window: DEV only, 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30 (sealed VALIDATION and HOLDOUT windows were not read)

verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE: 0 of 9 cells pass the gross screen

why: 9 of 9 primary arms are marked FAIL; the other cells carry no tuned rule.
Every mean is within a few hundredths of a percent and mostly inside its standard error, so there is no sign of an edge even before fees.

Verdict as written: INCONCLUSIVE - 0 of 9 frozen cells pass the gross DEV screen. FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE: stop; this atlas adopts no rule and the cells are not tuned or re-cut; any strategy needs its own PRE_REG with Binance-venue costs, VALIDATION once, HOLDOUT sealed.

examples.title: Primary arms (gross, % per event)
examples.caption: Gross mean of the 12-bar signed return. No example trades exported: this study counts events, it has no trade list.
